data.name: Settings_Intro
data.value: Appearance and language are saved locally. Audio and window options are labelled with their real status — nothing pretends to work.

data.name: Settings_LanguageNote
data.value: Language takes effect after a restart.

data.name: Settings_AppearanceNote
data.value: Theme and text size apply immediately and are saved locally.

data.name: Settings_MicTestHint
data.value: Speak into the microphone; the level bar moving means the input chain works.

data.name: Settings_MicTestUnavailable
data.value: Media core unavailable — cannot test the microphone.

data.name: Settings_SpeakerTestUnavailable
data.value: Requires media-core support (the current DLL has no playback-test export); not available in this version.

data.name: Settings_CloseToTray
data.value: Keep running in the tray when closed

data.name: Settings_HotkeysNote
data.value: Requires system-wide hotkey registration (Windows RegisterHotKey); not implemented in this version. The keys below do nothing.

data.name: Settings_PathHistory
data.value: Voice / screen path changes (decided by the server; the client exposes no direct/relay switch)

data.name: Settings_ServerAdminHint
data.value: Manage members, invites, bans and server settings. Only the owner can change dangerous settings such as transport mode.

data.name: Update_Available
data.value: Version v{0} is available. Choose “Update now” to download and restart.

data.name: Update_Portable
data.value: Portable build: download new versions manually, in-app updates are unavailable.

data.name: Update_Failed
data.value: Update check failed (network or update feed unavailable). Try again later.

data.name: Update_DownloadFailed
data.value: Update download failed. Please try again later.

data.name: Update_ServerVersionUnknown
data.value: Server version unknown (not connected to a server)

data.name: UpdatePrompt_Message
data.value: Version v{0} is available (current v{1}). Download it now and restart the app when it finishes?

data.name: Settings_AudioNote
data.value: Input/output device selection, level meters and playback tests are not wired into the UI yet (P3); no fake device values are shown here.

data.name: Settings_StartupNote
data.value: Keep-in-tray is wired; launch-at-startup writes the current user's Run entry on Windows, and the checkbox reflects the real registry state (not a local cache).

data.name: Settings_EvidenceNote
data.value: Screenshots do not prove a feature works; real sign-in, channels, text and media are verified by server logs / window evidence.

data.name: Settings_AudioHotSwitchOn
data.value: This media core supports hot-switching during a call: changes apply immediately.

data.name: Settings_AudioHotSwitchOff
data.value: This media core cannot hot-switch during a call: changes apply the next time you join voice.

data.name: Settings_AudioDeviceMissing
data.value: The device you selected earlier is gone; fell back to the system default.

data.name: Settings_AudioUnavailable
data.value: Media core unavailable — cannot list devices.

data.name: Settings_MicTestNoSignal
data.value: No level received: check microphone permission, the mute key, or the selected device.

data.name: Settings_MicTestInCall
data.value: Cannot start the test while in a voice call; leave voice first, or watch the level on your member card.

data.name: CloseDialog_Message
data.value: Keep PartyUp running in the tray, or quit?

data.name: CloseDialog_Remember
data.value: Remember my choice and do not ask again
